text:
Rosa (Partnerships): quick preflight for CloudForge marketplace + GPU partner bundle. We have 3 buckets: listing, co-marketing, and technical validation. Need owners + deadlines by EOD.
Diego (Sales): I'll own sales enablement assets (one-pager, playbook). Deadline?
Rosa (Partnerships): Sales assets by May 15.
Maya (Product): Product will provide integration guide + sample config by May 10. We'll include a troubleshooting section for GPU passthrough.
Ethan (Marketing): I'll own landing page copy + paid creative. Can we agree on hero messaging? Options: "Enterprise LLMs on CloudForge GPUs" vs "Predictable inference, now on CloudForge". Thoughts?
CloudForge - Partner: Prefer the latter 1Predictable inference, now on CloudForge\u00b4. Aligns with our messaging.
Jun (Eng): Technical validation: need partner-provided instance types, AMI/container image tag, and test dataset. We can run perf tests May 11-12 if we get access by May 9.
Rosa (Partnerships): CloudForge, can you confirm test access window?
CloudForge - Partner: We'll grant a staging org by May 8 and create creds for Jun. Also will provide a GPU-optimized VM image and driver notes.
Diego (Sales): For enablement, I need 2 customer-use-case bullets and pricing guidance (list vs marketplace fee) to tailor playbook.
Maya (Product): Use these bullets: "low-latency inference for chat ops" and "batch embedding pipelines for search". Pricing guidance: use partner marketplace list price + Redwood usage fee; I'll sync exact model for marketplace SKU math by May 9.
Ethan (Marketing): Draft CTA for microsite:
```
https://redwood.ai/marketplace/cloudforge-gpu?utm_source=cloudforge&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=cloudforge_bundle_launch
```
Jun (Eng): Also request UTM param partner_version to capture hardware SKU on clicks.
Ethan (Marketing): added. New CTA link will include partner_version param.
Rosa (Partnerships): Co-marketing budget ask: CloudForge committed $8k. We have an extra $5k discretionary. How to split?
Diego (Sales): Recommend 70% paid social + 30% field events.
Ethan (Marketing): 70/30 fine. I'll build paid plan, targeting dev tools and platform engs.
CloudForge - Partner: For assets: logos (SVG), 2 product screenshots (PNG 1280x720), short partner quote, and legal-approved co-brand guidelines. We'll upload to shared drive by May 6.
Maya (Product): For listing copy we need a 140-char summary and 3 bullets for features. I'll draft by May 7 and post here.
Jun (Eng): Test plan: 1) smoke start/stop 2) perf 95th p99 latency at tps 50 3) billing meter verification 4) logs and trace propagation. We'll publish results to the staging results doc.
Rosa (Partnerships): Great. Owners recap: Sales assets - Diego (May 15); Product docs - Maya (May 10); Marketing landing + creative - Ethan (May 9); Engineering tests - Jun (run May 11-12); Partner assets upload - CloudForge (May 6).
infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: "CloudForge Marketplace Launch Tests" on 2026-05-11 09:00 UTC.
Diego (Sales): Small ask: can Partnerships circulate an internal FAQ for partners/resellers? I'll draft and need review by May 12.
Rosa (Partnerships): Yes. Diego draft & share by May 12, I'll review.
Ethan (Marketing): Social copy draft sample:
"Run production LLMs with predictable latency on CloudForge GPUs + Redwood Inference. Learn more -> link"
Maya (Product): Suggest adding a sentence about security controls for enterprises.
Ethan (Marketing): Updated.
Jun (Eng): If tests fail, contingency: revert to soft-launch (marketplace listing hidden) and run partner blog spotlight while we fix issues. Agree?
CloudForge - Partner: Agreed. We prefer listing live only after green on perf and billing tests.
Rosa (Partnerships): Final note: legal wants to review co-marketing copy by May 8. Ethan, ping legal when draft ready.
Ethan (Marketing): Will do. Posting initial landing draft to #marketing-drafts tonight.
Rosa (Partnerships): Thanks everyone. I'll run 10min checkpoint each morning next week at 9am PT in this thread. Post any blockers ASAP. :white_check_mark:
CloudForge - Partner: Thanks! We'll prioritize assets and staging creds. :rocket:
